identifier.reasoning: This column names the biological trait or variable being analyzed in the study.

t-value/z-value.reasoning: This column holds the calculated test statistic (t or z value) for the measurement.

P-value.reasoning: This column holds the probability value (p-value) associated with the statistical test.

Regression coefficient β.reasoning: This column holds the regression coefficient (beta) quantifying the relationship.

Marginal $R^{2}$.reasoning: This column holds the marginal R-squared value, indicating variance explained.

Conditional $R^{2}$.reasoning: This column holds the conditional R-squared value, indicating variance explained.
